environment: maven:3.9.6-eclipse-temurin-21; production files compared byte-for-byte against pinned archive
scope: Actual Han’s Dice after a battle destiny draw, with the chosen character unchanged, departed, returned, or reset to ability 2, plus the original destiny card moved to hand during responses. Native-only regressions cover exact pending action/window binding, historical card references, malformed snapshot rejection, nested actual Sense/Alter commands, serialization and public projection.
limitations: This is component conformance, not full card/deck admission. Broader cancellation prevention, draw selection providers, ships/vehicles and complete engine/product scope remain.
